revocation_progress.Predicate: Unsafe==0 and BA.Decision!=Refused and (!Revoked or BA.Applied or BA.Permit)
revocation_progress.HashEncoding: JSONL in deterministic BFS discovery order; arc records are From/To/Successor-index in unchanged Successors

split_audit.search_criterion: From the post-admission initial cut: minimum total event count for pairs, then left length, then left/right event-order lexicographic paths; individual witnesses minimize length then event-order lexicographic path. Event order: launch, ingress, apply(v1), apply(v2), response, record, consume, revoke-b, lose-owner, reopen, fresh-refuse. Negative cut must be stopped/revoked with packet pending ingress; its extension ingresses/applies while stopped. Recovery ends in consume from a reopened/revoked source. Supplied shortest target prefixes alone do not determine history-qualified witnesses.
